explication: Kong is a Go library for turning a Go struct and its tags into a command-line interface. The main workflow starts when an application supplies its CLI structure and arguments: Kong builds a command model, scans and parses input into a Context, maps values, validates them, and makes the selected command available to run. Separate capabilities include generated contextual help, custom decoders, configuration and external defaults, hooks, dynamic commands, and dependency injection. The graph follows README-documented behavior and sampled files; unsampled implementation details are not asserted.
